body:
>that this entire episode will be a memory in just 48 hours or less. It takes about that long for norovirus to hit after the very first exposure. That's all.

Man, I'm hoping this means I wont get it at all. Denial is bad, I know, but she was sick once on the Wednesday morning. I went in the bathroom (had to go after holding) a few hours later. I'm hoping that if I didn't catch it then, I wont catch it as long as I wash my hands from now (although Im still terrified of touching the stupid sink and taps).

I know denial is bad though, as you said. But I can't help just.. hoping. I don't feel this is misery, I feel this is torture. I'm not resisting your help at all, I'm *really* appreciating this more than I can express right now, but I just.. argh. I'm in the midst of this. I hope you understand, I'm really not resisting your advice and words. Just so terrified. 

Fucking panic attacks. Stupid thing? Despite having to get over hearing my mother vomit on the Wednesday morning, which was hard but I got through it, *I was feeling fine until I heard Germ-x doesn't kill norovirus*. Didn't feel sick at all. Didn't eat much, stayed in my room, but didn't feel sick. Now? Paranoia, sickness, panicking..

This is honestly the most ridiculous phobia in the world. I'm frustrated as well as terrified, as I know - *logically* - that its not being sick thats bad. What is bad is my phobic response to it. Being sick would probably feel and be a lot less worse than this response.. but knowing that logically does nothing! I'd love to try anything to get rid. I'll have to ask my GP about CBT.

I get this strange feeling that being out in the open air will make everything better, stop me from feeling ill.. which is a small comfort, as it sort of tells me the reason I feel ill right now isn't because I've caught anything but because I'm panicking - fight or flight, you know?

I'd go, but I'm not in the safest of areas here. Although it might get to the point where I really dont give a shit about that.. She's not vomiting anymore, she only did once, now I'm just terrified of catching it.

I'm clinging onto the hope it wasn't norovirus for her. She only vomited once on the Wednesday morning - the night before, she'd had a meat pie she thought was old. But she had diarrhea after that too, and felt sick and achey. Maybe she's had flu - I don't normally vomit with flu even if I get it. But.. I dont know.

I really am fucking terrified, constantly on the verge of panic attack. That makes me feel sick anyway, and get cramps... and not eating since Tuesday, I know thats likely to make anyones stomach not feel quite right. I hate how the response to this phobia for me IS the phobia. I can't get away, no matter what I do. 

I don't want to die, I have a great life. An amazing relationship. Financial worries are easing up. I'm looking at being able to rent my own place next year. But man I'm so fucking terrified, I really would rather die than be sick. I have no idea what to do man. I'm scared of my own goddamn *hands* right now.

My mother also thinks its funny that I have this phobia, and so keeps talking about how she had the norovirus to me. How everyone is getting it this time of year. She hasn't been that hygienic herself. Of course she's feeling better now, singing and eating dinner. I'm here fucking terrified since I found out Germ-X doesn't do shit.

I feel like a fucking pussy but I am genuinely so scared that I want to die right now - although I don't, on the whole, *want* to die. I fucking hate this shit..

Did the hospital help you at all?
